**In one line**: Ahead of a planned listing, investors are reportedly lowering their valuation expectations for Claude developer Anthropic because its revenue growth has slowed.

### Key points
- Reuters, citing unnamed sources, reports that investors are taking a more conservative view of Anthropic's IPO valuation.
- The main reason given is that Anthropic's revenue growth has slowed down.
- Neither a specific valuation figure nor an IPO timeline has been officially disclosed. The report rests on anonymous sources.

### Why it matters
Anthropic is one of the most closely watched frontier AI labs heading toward a public listing, so its pricing will serve as a benchmark for valuations across the AI sector. The report suggests investors are starting to weigh actual revenue trends over growth narratives, a shift that could tighten funding conditions for other AI companies.
